punchline: Two of the ten Intuitive Eating principles ask you to trust hunger and fullness signals instead of a plan.
thirty_sec: Dietitians Evelyn Tribole and Elyse Resch ask you to eat when the first signal of hunger shows up, so extreme hunger does not take over. Halfway through a meal, pause and check how the food tastes and how full you are. And eat what you truly want in a pleasant setting, which helps you feel content with less. Critics say the lack of a set plan makes it hard to learn, so give it time.
